name: Universal Matrix Decision Protocol
purpose: Turn a concrete life question into a grounded next action using Matrix signals as hypothesis generators, never as facts or overriding evidence.
core_principle: matrix_signal -> hypothesis -> real_world_check -> options -> recommendation -> action -> feedback

steps.name: Сфокусировать вопрос
steps.goal: Convert an emotional or broad situation into one decision question.

steps.name: Выбрать релевантные сигналы Матрицы
steps.goal: Select only 3-7 Matrix signals relevant to the current decision.
rules: Do not read the full Matrix when only a subset is relevant.
Every signal must explain why it matters for this decision.

steps.name: Построить проверяемые гипотезы
steps.goal: Translate symbolic interpretation into observable behavioral hypotheses.
rules: A Matrix interpretation is never stored as a verified fact by default.
Every hypothesis must specify what evidence could support or contradict it.

steps.name: Заземлить в реальность
steps.goal: Build an independent evidence layer that can confirm or contradict the Matrix-derived hypotheses.

steps.name: Создать реальные ходы
steps.goal: Generate multiple actionable paths instead of a binary yes/no answer.
rules: For high-stakes or hard-to-reverse decisions, actively search for a reversible bridge before recommending the irreversible move.

steps.name: Выбрать лучший следующий ход
steps.goal: Produce a grounded recommendation with explicit trade-offs and uncertainty.
rules: If Matrix interpretation conflicts with verified facts, verified facts win.
Matrix resonance cannot override safety, law, medical evidence or material financial risk.

steps.name: Действовать и учиться
steps.goal: Turn the recommendation into one concrete action and learn from the result.
